prediction.rationale:
Cooler: full efficiency. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 30.9 °C (within 1% of healthy); TS1 temperature slope 0.384 °C/min (3% below healthy). Heat exchanger maintains expected fluid cooling delta without thermal drift.
Valve: small lag. Evidence: PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.83 s (within 1% of healthy); PS2 pressure rise time 9.46 s (within 2% of healthy). A small switching delay appears during the main pressure transient, reflecting early valve degradation.
Pump leakage: severe leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.40 l/min (3% below healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 400 W·min/l (4% above healthy); SE system efficiency factor 55.8 % (5% below healthy). High power-to-flow ratio demonstrates extensive internal leakage across the pump chambers.
Accumulator: close to total failure. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 47.1 bar (within 1% of healthy). Pressure buffering is largely ineffective due to compromised pre-charge pressure in the accumulator.

tslm_prediction.rationale:
Cooler: full efficiency. Evidence: TS1 temperature slope 0.41 °C/min (4% above healthy); TS4 mean temperature 30.6 °C (within 1% of healthy). Operating temperatures and thermal gradient remain within optimal baseline specifications.
Valve: severe lag. Evidence: PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.89 s (within 1% of healthy); PS2 pressure rise time 9.56 s (3% above healthy). Transient response is severely sluggish, preventing timely transition of working pressure.
Pump leakage: weak leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.49 l/min (within 1% of healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 393 W·min/l (2% above healthy); SE system efficiency factor 56.8 % (3% below healthy). Volumetric delivery is slightly compromised due to minor internal bypass flow.
Accumulator: optimal. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 47.5 bar (within 2% of healthy). Pressure stability and surge dampening meet full design specifications.
